description:
> *This was generated by AI from the defk-2mz design session (2026-10-12).*

## Agent Brief

**Category:** enhancement (refactor, no behaviour change)
**Summary:** Move the compiler's range facts onto the symbolic-bounds representation of ADR-0007 (atoms, forms, env facts, one prover), with no change to the generated C.

**Design:** docs/adr/0007-symbolic-bounds.md (accepted) and docs/research/relational-facts.md sections 1, 3, 4 and 8 (step 1).

**Current behavior:**
Facts are per-kind fields: `lo`/`hi`, `lb`/`ub`, `len_lo`/`len_lb` and defk-upc's scaled facts, used by `in_bounds?/3`, `i64_arith`, `range_limit`, stores, and `with_acc_facts/2` (with `lost_facts?/2`), and named by the fast-path report.

**Desired behavior:**
- Atoms (i64 bindings' C variables and array lengths) ranked by binding order; values carry their exact form; the env carries the facts of atoms in scope.
- One prover deciding `D <= 0` by substituting the newest atom's bounds, with a step budget; an unproven query keeps the check.
- `lb`/`ub`/`len_lo`/`len_lb` and the scaled facts become forms and facts (`lo`/`hi` stay). `with_acc_facts/2` uses prover implication instead of `lost_facts?/2`.
- The proof's support goes into the C as a marker that `fixed_indices?/3` can read (for defk-5qk and step 3).
- Budgets measured, not guessed: set the step budget and bounds-per-atom cap from the suite and the examples.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- [ ] A switch dumps the generated C of every test kernel and example; before and after this ticket it is byte-identical (support markers aside, if they are comments, say so)
- [ ] Compiler time (`Defk.Compiler.compile`, clang excluded) on the suite and examples within 5% of before, measured on a quiet machine; budget and cap values with their measurements recorded in docs/performance.md
- [ ] defk-fun's accumulator carry is re-expressed through the prover and its tests pass unchanged
- [ ] `mix test`, `mix docs`, `mix credo --strict` clean

**Out of scope:**
- Any new source of facts (steps 2-4); report text changes

comments.text: PR #28 opened. Gate byte-identical over 101 files; compiler time +2.4%; prover max 5/64 steps over 41,016 queries, max 4 bounds per value. env.facts and the C support marker deferred to defk-qdz (no scalar atoms yet). Ticket stays in progress until the merge.

title: Symbolic bounds core: move range facts onto ADR-0007's representation, no behaviour change
